description: Type apps.versions.delete's HTTP 400 'Invalid argument provided.' for a version a just-deleted deployment still references. It surfaced as a generic BadRequest; the same delete succeeds once the deployment is gone, so callers retry it.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The app version is still referenced by a deployment that is being deleted (HTTP 400 'Invalid argument provided.'). Retryable until the deployment is gone.
